title: APV 脑图用例编译

inputs.mindmap: path of the mindmap JSON export in the workspace: a one-element [root] array, cases carry an 18-digit data.autoid
inputs.versionLine: the product version line, such as 10.5
inputs.build: optional: the build to write for; the latest formal build of the version line otherwise
inputs.files: on the server: the mindmap file itself, [{path, base64}]

model: any capable model; prep, checks and the workbook are scripts
